visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-viewport rotating hero with photo slides, overlay text and labelled tab navigation
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-viewport (900px) photo slides with dark overlay, white uppercase condensed title, white body text, arrow-link CTA; bottom tab nav with slide labels (SIAMO TERNA, OPERE, STRATEGIA, TWIN TRANSITION) and stop/play button. Slide 4 has a Play video button.

contentPattern.summary: Full-viewport photo slides with overlay text, CTA and labelled tab navigation (play/stop control); differs from the KPI slider by full-bleed images and text tabs.
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide. Cell 1: background image. Cell 2: title (heading), description, CTA link (a YouTube/Vimeo/.mp4 link opens a video dialog instead). Optional cell 3: short tab label (defaults to the slide heading). Rotates automatically with a stop/play button unless reduced motion is preferred
contentPattern.sourceContent: 4 slides: photo background, title, description, "Scopri di più" link (slide 4: video play instead of link); tab labels per slide

usage: Homepage top hero with 2-6 rotating messages, each needing its own tab label.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-bleed photo slides with text tabs. For stat/number slides use carousel-kpi; for a single static photo banner use hero-banner.
